items.title: 27.3.2 Enzyme catalysed reactions mein inhibitors ka kirdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of enzyme inhibitors (PDF 168-169).

blocks.text: Woh chhote molecules ya ions jo enzymes ki catalytic sargarmi khatam karein inhibitors hain. Mukhtalif inhibitors mukhtalif tareeqe se kaam karte hain, lekin sab active site ko substrate se jurne se rokte hain.

items: Competitive (reversible) inhibitors ki shakal substrate jaisi hoti hai. Substrate aur inhibitor active site ke liye muqabla karte hain; inhibitor jitna zyada, enzyme apne substrate ke liye utna ghair fa'aal. Maslan butanedioate (succinate, -OOC-CH2-CH2-COO-) enzyme succinate dehydrogenase se oxidise hota hai, aur propanedioate (malonate, -OOC-CH2-COO-) succinate se mushabeh hone ki wajah se is enzyme ko rokta hai.

Non-competitive inhibitors, jinhein kitab irreversible samajhti hai, chhote ions ya molecules hain jo active site ki shakal badal dete hain taa ke woh substrate ke liye dastiyab na rahe. Jis enzyme se irreversible inhibitor, jaise zehr, antibiotic, anti-metabolite ya kuch dawaiyan, jur jaye woh hamesha ke liye apni sargarmi kho deta hai; aisi rokawat sehat ke sangeen masail ya maut ka sabab ban sakti hai. Penicillin enzyme transpeptidase ka irreversible inhibitor hai, jo bacteria ko cell wall banane ke liye chahiye, is liye penicillin cell wall ki tayyari bigar kar bacteria ko maarti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Cobra ke zehr mein enzyme phospholipase A2 (PLA2) hota hai jo khoon ke surkh cells ki jhilliyan tor sakta hai, jis se haemolysis, mutasira uzw ki sojan aur aakhir mein maut hoti hai.

blocks.title: Do ghalatiyan durust
blocks.text: Kitab penicillin bayan karne ke baad kehti hai 'is liye insulin bacteria ko maarta hai'; bacteria ko penicillin maarti hai. Yeh enzyme ka naam 'dehydrogenase succinate' bhi deti hai; naam succinate dehydrogenase hai.

blocks.prompt: Enzymes inorganic catalysts se kaise mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: Enzymes proteins hain; yeh bohat makhsoos (aik substrate), bohat tez, narm halaat (taqreeban 37 C, taqreeban neutral pH) mein kaam karte aur garmi ya ghalat pH se denature hote hain. Inorganic catalysts kam makhsoos, aksar zyada darja hararat chahte aur denature nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: Darja hararat kam aur zyada karne ka enzyme ki sargarmi par kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation: Darja hararat kam karna reaction ko sust karta hai (kam aur halki takkarein) baghair enzyme ko tabah kiye. Barhana optimum tak sargarmi barhata; us se oopar enzyme denature hota aur sargarmi tezi se girti hai.

blocks.prompt: Competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Competitive inhibitor substrate jaisa hota aur active site se ulat sakne wale tareeqe se jurta; zyada substrate milane se is par qaboo paya ja sakta hai. Non-competitive inhibitor kaheen aur jur kar active site ki shakal badalta; zyada substrate se is par qaboo nahi hota (kitab inhein irreversible samajhti hai).

blocks.prompt: Enzyme protein hai. Protein ki banawat ke hawale se samjhayein ke pH ki tabdeeli us ka kaam kaise bigarti hai.
blocks.explanation: pH tezaabi aur basic side chains (-COOH/-COO-, -NH2/-NH3+) ke charges badalta hai. Is se tertiary structure thaamne wale ionic aur hydrogen bonds toot'te, active site ki shakal badalti aur substrate fit nahi hota (enzyme denature hota hai).

items: Competitive inhibitors substrate ki naqal (succinate ke liye malonate).
Non-competitive inhibitors active site badalte; zehr aur penicillin hamesha ke liye.
pH aur garmi enzymes ko denature karte.
